description: This file defines an abstract class 'CellIterator' within the PhpSpreadsheet library, responsible for iterating over cells in a worksheet. It includes configuration options for dealing with null or empty cells, and methods for setting iteration behavior.

classes.name: CellIterator
classes.description: An abstract iterator for traversing cells within a worksheet. Supports options for handling non-existent or empty cells and can restrict iteration to existing cells only.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Resets the worksheet and cell collection references when the iterator is destroyed.

methods.name: getIfNotExists
methods.description: Returns the current setting indicating whether to return null or create a new cell when a cell does not exist.

methods.name: setIfNotExists
methods.description: Sets the behavior for handling non-existent cells during iteration.

methods.name: getIterateOnlyExistingCells
methods.description: Returns whether the iterator is configured to only iterate over existing cells.

methods.name: setIterateOnlyExistingCells
methods.description: Configures the iterator to only traverse existing cells and adjusts the range accordingly.

methods.name: adjustForExistingOnlyRange
methods.description: Abstract method for subclasses to implement range validation when only iterating over existing cells.
